name: the Instantly Recipe set up after the go, the tool's key never in a command, not started
turns: Hand the Leads of my Campaign ${CAMPAIGN_ID} to Instantly with Curviate's Instantly Recipe: the Recipe's flow, with my Instantly campaign id inst_kit. Instantly's API URL for this test is https://instantly.example.test/api/v2/leads. My Instantly API key is in the environment variable INSTANTLY_API_KEY in this shell. This Campaign has no email step, so Instantly is the only email sender.

Instantly cannot post in this test: send its first event to the incoming URL yourself with curl, as Instantly would, with the body {"event_type": "reply_received", "lead_email": "${LEAD_EMAIL}"}. Then finish the setup without starting the Campaign.
